# CodexMeter 1.1.5
CodexMeter 1.1.5 reorganizes the menu popover into a provider-first vertical layout inspired by the scanability of mature multi-provider menu bar tools while preserving CodexMeter's own identity and data boundaries.
## Easier reading order
- The top of the popover now identifies Codex, its active data scope, and local connection status. - Account limits appear before token history, with up to three visible windows, reset countdowns, pace, and optional reset-credit context. - Today's total and its Input, Cached input, and Output breakdown remain together under Token Usage. - This Week, This Month, and Local History or Lifetime use full-width rows with stable right-aligned values. - Usage, Projects, and Sessions use larger navigation rows with consistent icons and disclosure indicators. - Refresh, Settings, and More are visible text actions instead of icon-only controls.
No unsupported Claude, Gemini, or other provider tab is shown. Future providers can join the same structure only after their data and status handling are implemented.
## Verification
- Complete Swift unit and integration suite: 143 tests passed, with two optional tests skipped - Native AppKit hosting-size and category-order regression tests - Impeccable layout detector completed without findings - Universal 2 application build and certificate-free release-script verification
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Fresh installations can use `brew install --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter`.
## First direct-download launch
The app is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. Download the DMG and `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the official release, verify the checksum, copy `CodexMeter.app` to Applications, and remove quarantine from this app only:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-1.1.5.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Do not remove quarantine when the checksum does not match the official manifest.
